title: Guess the Clicks!
intro.text: A random YouTube video plays on the TV. How many views does it have?
guess.title: How many views?
guess.change: You can change it while time is running.
scores.title: Scores
final.title: Final scores
setup.title: One-time setup
setup.text: For real, current view counts UP! needs a free YouTube API key.
setup.step2: Under “APIs & Services → Library”, enable “YouTube Data API v3”.
setup.step4: Paste the key here on the TV under Settings (gear) for “Guess the Clicks!”.
setup.phone: The host still needs to set up this game.
error.title: No videos found
error.quota: The API key's daily quota is used up. It resets tomorrow.
error.key: The API key is invalid or YouTube Data API v3 isn't enabled.
audience.wait: You're in the audience. Guess anyway – just for fun!
setup.step4tv: Paste the key on the right – or more comfortably on your phone, which has the same field.
setup.step4phone: Paste the key below and save.
setup.phoneHint: Tip: copy and paste is usually easiest on a phone.
setup.scan: Scan the QR code to open the Google page
error.network: Can't reach YouTube. Is the computer online?
mode.best.intro: The closest guess gets one point.
mode.rank.intro: Points by rank: closest gets 1000, last gets 0 – everyone in between accordingly.
mode.distance.intro: The closer, the more points: spot on 1000, double or half 700, 10× off 0.
mode.bonus.intro: The closer, the more points (up to 1000) – plus +250 for the closest and +500 for almost spot on.
mode.distance.short: Everyone scores – the closer, the more
mode.bonus.short: The closer, the more · closest +250 · almost spot on +500
